title: oncidium hymenanthum
intro: Oncidium hymenanthum, commonly known as the Hymenanthum orchid, is a species of flowering orchid. It is a type of epiphytic orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The Hymenanthum orchid is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilatory and antioxidant effects.
